author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
The U.S. has ended Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Haitians and is deporting people back to a country where gangs control much of the capital and where returnees can face kidnapping, violence and extreme instability.

After years of political turmoil and the 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moïse, armed groups expanded their power through kidnapping, extortion and control of key roads and economic hubs.

Watch FRONTLINE's full documentary to see what Haitians deported from the U.S. are returning to and how Haiti's security crisis reached this point.
title: How did Haiti's Gangs Become so Powerful?
